title: Expand recovery test matrix for concurrency and failure paths
problem: Current recovery tests are strong on happy path but under-cover destructive confirm, concurrent operations, and restore failure consistency.
implementation_outline: Add destructive restore confirm branch tests.
Add concurrent restore/rollback tests against shared workspace fixtures.
Add failure injection assertions for persistence consistency and UI-facing behavior.
acceptance_criteria: New failure/concurrency scenarios are reproducible and stable.
Tests assert both API result and persisted state consistency.
Existing core workflow tests remain green.
